tools/reactquerygen drift tests from checked-in OpenAPI
manual package/delivery workflow with target-path allowlist and generated PR body

Terraform plan/apply evidence and drift policy
Terraform evidence, rollback policy, and exported deployment group names

rules: Public PR checks must not require AWS credentials, Terraform state, ECR access, production secret material, or write access to riido-client.
Tag/manual runtime CD may use live AWS only outside pull_request gates.
Runtime artifact CD execution remains owned by riido-control-plane while topology and private evidence remain owned by riido-infra.
Private gates may consume public tags and redacted summaries but must not push account-specific state or raw secret values back to this public repository.
Docker is optional for local release preparation and is not a required public PR dependency.

loop.observation: The integration matrix was manual prose describing the public/private verification boundary.
loop.hypothesis: A manifest can make PR-safe and operator-only verification boundaries checkable without live infrastructure.
loop.execute: Generate this reader from the matrix manifest and verify workflow/command evidence in CI.
loop.evaluate: The verifier checks gate counts, workflow existence, pull-request trigger classification, forbidden PR dependency wording, generated doc freshness, and evidence output.
loop.retrospective: This keeps public CI low-cost while preserving an explicit place for private/operator evidence.
